uiLanguage.title: Display language
uiLanguage.description: WebView UI language. Use auto to follow OpenIDEA's default UI language.

engine.title: Translation engine
engine.description: Active translation backend used by editor commands, document translation, and the Translation panel.

instantTranslation.title: Instant translation while typing
instantTranslation.description: Automatically translate after a short typing pause inside the Translation panel.

primaryLanguage.title: Primary language
primaryLanguage.description: Preferred target language when translating text written in another language (smart Primary <-> Secondary mode).

secondaryLanguage.title: Secondary language
secondaryLanguage.description: Fallback target language used automatically when the source text is already in your primary language.

targetLanguage.title: Default target language
targetLanguage.description: Explicit target language, or auto to switch intelligently between primary and secondary languages.

targetLanguageSelection.title: Automatic target language strategy
targetLanguageSelection.description: How auto target language is resolved: primary switches Primary <-> Secondary, last prefers your most recent target language when non-primary, and default picks Primary unless source is already Primary.

autoSelectionMode.title: Auto-selection mode
autoSelectionMode.description: How words are auto-selected when there is no editor selection: inclusive picks the whole identifier, exclusive picks the CamelCase/snake_case word under caret.

autoSplitWords.title: Split CamelCase & snake_case words
autoSplitWords.description: Split code identifiers like getUserProfile or user_auth_token into separate words before translating.

separators.title: Identifier separator characters
separators.description: Custom separator characters split as word boundaries inside code identifiers (default: _-.).

ignoreRegExp.title: Ignore regular expression
ignoreRegExp.description: Optional Rust regex pattern stripped before translating selected text or comments (e.g. ^\s*//\s*|^\s*\*\s*).

showHoverTranslation.title: Show cached & Word Book translations on hover
showHoverTranslation.description: Display instant zero-network dictionary translations from cache and Word Book inside editor hover popups.

showDocAnnotations.title: Allow inline comment translation annotations
showDocAnnotations.description: Enable toggling end-of-line translated comment annotations via Translation: Toggle Inline Comment Translation.

preferredNamingStyle.title: Preferred naming style for Translate & Replace
preferredNamingStyle.description: Naming format placed first when replacing selected text with an English translation.

cacheEnabled.title: Enable persistent translation cache
cacheEnabled.description: Cache recent translations locally for instant hover lookups and faster repeat translations.

cacheTtlHours.title: Translation cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: Hours before cached entries expire (0 disables automatic expiration).

maxHistoryItems.title: Translation history limit
maxHistoryItems.description: Maximum number of recent translation history records stored locally (10-500).

showWordsOnStartup.title: Show Word of the Day on startup
showWordsOnStartup.description: Show a notification with a Word Book review item when OpenIDEA finishes starting up.
